blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Taxes can sound hard, but in English they follow simple patterns. In "The Government and the Company", you learn the words that appear on Czarnikow's forms and reports.

The taxpayer is the company. The government asks for the forms. The accountant checks the numbers. She is careful, and she is slow, because every number must be correct.

Today you learn five useful words and practise them in short sentences. Go slowly — one step at a time. You can do it!

items.q: Who is the taxpayer in the text?
items.why: "The taxpayer is the company." O contribuinte é a empresa.

items.q: Why is the accountant slow?
options: Because the office is far away
Because every number must be correct
items.why: "she is slow, because every number must be correct."

items.q: According to the text, taxes in English are…
items.why: "in English they follow simple patterns." O texto diz que dá para praticar.

items.q: The words "one step at a time" suggest that the author wants you to…
items.why: Inferência: o tom é de calma e encorajamento — devagar, sem pressa.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: you can learn tax words with practice
taxes are too hard for beginners
items.why: Inferência: "You can do it!" e "practise them" mostram que o autor acredita que dá para aprender.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o time fiscal e o governo. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello! My name is Sophie. I work in the tax department. Today I want to show you my team.

This is Paul. He is our accountant. He checks the numbers every week. He is careful and he is calm. When I have a question, I ask him.

The company is the taxpayer. We send the forms to the government. The government reads the forms and answers us. It is a simple process, but it must be correct.

Our office is small, but we are a good team. Every employee helps. We work together, and we finish before the deadline. I like my job because the work is clear.

Taxes are just one more part of the company's routine. One small step at a time — and it becomes easy. You can do it too!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "I work in the tax department."

items.q: Who is Paul?
items.why: "This is Paul. He is our accountant."

items.q: Who does the company send the forms to?
items.why: "We send the forms to the government."

items.q: Sophie says the office is small. This suggests that…
options: the team cannot do good work
the team is still good and works well together
items.why: Inferência: "our office is small, but we are a good team." O tamanho não atrapalha.

items.q: How does Sophie feel about her job?
items.why: Inferência: "I like my job because the work is clear." O tom é positivo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The company is the taxpayer, so it must send the forms." A taxpayer is…
options: a person or company that pays taxes
items.why: Taxpayer = contribuinte, quem paga os impostos.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "The ___ checks all the numbers before we send the report."
items.why: Accountant = contador(a), a pessoa que confere os números.

items.q: "Sophie works in the tax department." A department is…
items.why: Department = departamento, uma área da empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Every ___ in our team helps before the deadline."
items.why: Employee = funcionário(a), cada pessoa do time.

items.q: "We keep the files in the office for seven years." An office is…
items.why: Office = escritório, o lugar onde as pessoas trabalham.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho fiscal. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The accountant must fill out the tax form." To fill out means to…
options: write the information on a form
items.why: Fill out = preencher (um formulário).

items.q: "We hand in the report on Friday." To hand in means to…
options: give or send something to someone
items.why: Hand in = entregar (algo a alguém ou a um órgão).

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the numbers." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente, dar o aval.

items.q: "Please follow up with the government next week." To follow up means to…
options: check again and ask about it
items.why: Follow up = dar seguimento, checar de novo.

items.q: "Let's check in with the team before the deadline." To check in means to…
options: talk and see how things are going
items.why: Check in = fazer um contato rápido para ver como está tudo.
